title: Quake SM '97 Prizes
wikitext:
The prizes handed out to the top finishers during the [[Quake SM '97]] were distributed as follows:

== Deathmatch (Free for all) prizes ==
=== 1st ===
* PC, 233MHz MMX Pentium, 64MB RAM, Matrox Mystique 4MB, and a 21" monitor
* One year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 2nd ===
* Soundblaster AWE64 Gold 8MB
* Signed version of MotorHead
* One year subscription for the PCGamer magazine
* DI T-shirt
* One year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 3rd ===
* 3dfx graphics cards
* Signed version of MotorHead
* One year subscription for the PCGamer magazine
* PCGamer T-shirt
* DI T-shirt
* One year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 4th ===
* Part year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 5th ===
* Part year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine


== Team Deathmatch prizes ==
These prizes were given out for each player of the teams, i.e. everything multiplied by four.

=== 1st ===
* 3dfx graphics card
* One year subscription for the PCGamer magazine
* One year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 2nd ===
* Signed version of MotorHead
* Part year subscription for the PCGamer magazine
* DI T-shirt
* Part year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 3rd ===
* DI T-shirt
* Signed version of MotorHead
* PCGamer T-shirt
* Part year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 4th ===
* Part year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine

=== 5th ===
* Part year subscription for the Attack Gamer magazine
